heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 23050136:3814.May 23, 1986, Pub. L. 99–318, § 15, 100 Stat. 476. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possessions of the United States”.
